recommended_storage: A protected one-to-one contractor/customer-account link supplies the existing sales customer_id without copying a name at command time.
A sale-contractor sidecar binds sale_id, contractor_id and the exact linked customer_id; the command refuses a missing, inactive or changed link.
Toko sales retain their current customer-only route and create no contractor sidecar.
buyer_identity.reason: The actual sales posting, FG movement lineage and AR journal are customer_id based. Making customer_id nullable or guessing a customer from contractor_name would fork the accepted stock/HPP/AR engine.

recommended_storage: An immutable allocation identity links one posted sale invoice to one exact payroll and contractor with an exact two-decimal amount and request identity.
Append-only allocation events represent RESERVE, RELEASE, SETTLE and SETTLEMENT_REVERSE; current reservation and settlement state is derived, not silently overwritten.
A settlement-line fact links every settled allocation to the exact payroll noncash journal and its lawful reversal.
allocation_model.active_reservation_limit: effective invoice open balance minus every active reservation on other payrolls
allocation_model.payroll_capacity_limit: current payroll net payable after every other current deduction

payment_accounting.cash_payment: Existing payroll cash/bank payment remains gross payable less all deductions, including the FG invoice deduction.
payment_accounting.wage_cost: Existing APPROVED payroll cost recognition remains unchanged and is not repeated at payment.
payment_accounting.invoice_projection: The exact linked settlement amount is added to effective paid/open-balance readers without creating an erp.sales_payments row.
payment_accounting.single_recording: Sale revenue, FG stock movement and COGS stay owned by existing sale posting; payroll creates only the noncash payable-to-AR settlement.

existing_hook_points.sales_posting: erp.post_sale(uuid) remains the only stock/HPP/revenue posting owner
existing_hook_points.sales_effective_paid: Current readers already separate raw erp.sales_payments from noncash effective-paid adjustments; add one explicit FG settlement projection rather than a fake cash payment.
existing_hook_points.payroll_final: erp.post_payroll_payment(uuid) and cp7_installment.final_payment(uuid,numeric) must both invoke the same private FG settlement owner exactly once.
existing_hook_points.payroll_reopen: cp7_installment.reopen_settlement(uuid,text) reverses the FG settlement while keeping the allocation reserved on the reopened APPROVED payroll.
existing_hook_points.payroll_full_reverse: erp.reverse_paid_payroll(uuid,text) reverses the FG settlement and releases the allocation because the payroll becomes REVERSED.
existing_hook_points.unpaid_cancel: erp.cancel_unpaid_payroll(uuid,text) releases reservations without any AR or GL effect.

lock_order: account mappings and exact journal rows
revalidation_after_locks: same contractor on payroll, sale sidecar and contractor/customer link
invoice still posted and effective open balance still covers all reservations
unchanged request payload for the same request UUID
concurrency_and_idempotency.double_click: Exact request replay returns the same committed outcome; changed intent with the same UUID refuses.
concurrency_and_idempotency.two_tabs: Serialized locks and aggregate re-read prevent over-allocation across payrolls.

balance_change_and_correction.return_or_other_payment: May change invoice balance through the existing lawful writer. The allocation review becomes stale; final payroll settlement refuses before effect until the allocation is reduced or released.
balance_change_and_correction.posted_history: No direct edit/delete of posted sale, payment, payroll settlement or settlement fact.
balance_change_and_correction.payroll_reversal: Uses exact linked journal reversal and append-only settlement inverse; never creates compensating cash.
balance_change_and_correction.sale_reversal: Refuses while an active paid FG settlement exists; owner must reverse the consuming payroll settlement first.
